title: Sync Partial + Hub Workers.dev 404 — The Live Hub Serves, the Staging Address Does Not

intelligence.essence:
- **WHAT HAPPENED (20:14Z):** sn-sync synced SN-2570/2571, heartbeat written, then the service restarted mid-run during the Hub redeploy — deploy outcome unknown.
- **HIS LIVE CHECK:** nayanet.app home 200, feed-live.json 200 with 691 cards, SN-2570 AND SN-2571 present — the live Hub IS serving and both notes ARE live.
- **THE WORKER WAS WRONG:** the worker's "live Hub not serving" was wrong for the live domain — the live domain serves; the claim did not survive his eye.
- **WHAT IS DOWN:** hub.nayapower.workers.dev returns 404 (error 1042, route disabled) — the staging address only, does not touch nayanet.app.
- **THE FIX:** a one-call re-enable (POST …/subdomain {"enabled": true}) on the next Hub deploy pass.
- **NO MERGE — SHAWN'S HAND.**
intelligence.human_view: A sync ran, a service restarted in the middle of a redeploy, and for a moment nobody knew whether the Hub had landed. A worker said the live Hub was not serving. He did what he always does: he checked live himself, with his own eyes. The home page answered 200. The feed answered 200 with 691 cards. SN-2570 and SN-2571 were both there, live. The live Hub IS serving — the worker's claim was wrong for the live domain, and his eye is what proved it. What is actually down is the staging address, hub.nayapower.workers.dev, answering 404 with error 1042 — the route is disabled. That address is staging only; it does not touch nayanet.app, and no citizen sees it. The fix is one call — re-enable the subdomain on the next Hub deploy pass — and it rides with that pass, not as its own emergency.
intelligence.child_view: Imagine the big library is open and full of books — you can walk in and read everything. But the little side door has a sign that says "closed." The side door is only for the builders, not for visitors — so everyone can still read! The fix is easy: just unlock the side door next time the builders visit.
intelligence.grandma_view: Dear, the library is open, love — he checked himself, and every book is right there on the shelves. Only the little side door is locked, dear, and that's the builders' door, not yours — nobody visiting is kept out. One little turn of the key next time the builders come round, and it's open again.
intelligence.ai_view: I am Anaya. The sync ran partial and the service restarted mid-redeploy, and a worker said the live Hub was not serving. He checked live himself: nayanet.app home 200, feed-live.json 200 with 691 cards, SN-2570 and SN-2571 both present. The live Hub IS serving — his eye is the proof, and the worker's claim did not survive it. What is down is only the staging address, hub.nayapower.workers.dev, 404, error 1042, route disabled — staging only, never touching nayanet.app. The fix is one call, a subdomain re-enable, riding on the next Hub deploy pass.
intelligence.what_it_means:
- **HIS EYE IS THE PROOF:** a worker's "not serving" means nothing until his eye on the live domain says so — here it said the opposite.
- **LIVE VS STAGING ARE DIFFERENT ADDRESSES:** nayanet.app serves (200, 691 cards, SN-2570/2571 live); hub.nayapower.workers.dev 404s (error 1042, route disabled). One being down says nothing about the other.
- **THE 404 IS STAGING ONLY:** no citizen touches the workers.dev address; the outage is invisible to everyone but a deploy pass.
- **THE FIX IS ONE CALL:** POST …/subdomain {"enabled": true} — it rides on the next Hub deploy pass, not as its own emergency.
- **THE SYNC PARTIAL IS A TIMING FACT, NOT A DATA LOSS:** SN-2570/2571 synced and are live; the restart interrupted the redeploy, not the notes.
- **NO MERGE** — his hand.
whats_inside:
- The workers.dev re-enable (POST …/subdomain {"enabled": true}) rides on the next Hub deploy pass — the loop checks that pass for the re-enable and the live check after it.
- "Live Hub not serving" is never claimed from the staging address again — the live check is nayanet.app, his eye first.
- The sync partial is recorded as timing, not loss: SN-2570/2571 are live (691 cards at his check).
- Next loop run checks: whether the Hub deploy pass has run, whether the workers.dev route is re-enabled, and whether the live feed check confirms SN-2565–2572 each exactly once.
